summary: Phase 2 EXPANSION of Marketing Studio Reels fully validated. Backend pytest: 10/10 passing in ~74s including 3 full FFmpeg renders covering (A) showcase + outro + energetica @10s, (B) services + subtitles + AI TTS voice-over (Emergent key) + outro + epica @15s, (C) before_after exactly 2 photos + no music @10s; plus 6-track music endpoint, epica audio bytes, before_after-with-1-photo 400 Spanish '2 fotos', no-photos 400, list+delete, and image-post regression with accent_color. Frontend Playwright e2e: login -> /marketing -> mode-reel renders ALL phase-2 selectors (5 templates, 3 durations, 4 motions, 6 transitions, 3 extras switches, 6 music + none + upload, 11 color themes). before_after correctly disables the transition group (opacity-40 + pointer-events-none). End-to-end generate flow (showcase 2 photos + brief + duration=10 + motion=auto + outro on + energetica) produced reel-video + reel-download-btn with video src pointing to /api/public/card/photo/{id}; reel-history populated and history-delete works. Image-mode regression: 10 template tiles still visible. UI 100% Spanish. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew further to 5295 lines. The 200+ line reels block (POST/GET/DELETE + _process_reel + music endpoints) is a strong candidate for extraction to /app/backend/routes/social_reels.py. Same recommendation as iteration_16 — still pending.

_process_reel passes brand_color/accent_color both directly and inside _social_brand. The downstream render_reel_full ignores accent_color when building the outro/subtitle palette beyond what _social_brand returns. Acceptable today but inconsistent contract.

POST /api/social/reels coerces invalid duration (e.g., 12) silently to 10. Consider returning 400 with a Spanish message so the UI sender knows. Today the frontend only exposes 10/15/20 so it is moot, but the API is public.

tts_service.generate_voiceover uses OpenAI tts-1 + voice=onyx hardcoded. For Spanish output the voice may sound less natural — consider passing language hints or switching to a multilingual voice (alloy/nova) when language='es'. Today both pass-throughs (en/es) work and produce a valid mp3; just a quality note.
DELETE /api/social/reels/{id} still leaves orphan source_src photos and uploaded music files in db.photos (carried over from iter_16). Reels that fail mid-render also keep orphans.

Frontend: ReelStudio.js is 436 lines — fine size-wise, but the music-track list, color list, transitions list, motions list could be moved to a shared constants module to avoid drift with backend video_service.TRANSITIONS/MOTIONS.

Generate button shows a generic success toast and switches the UI to the rendered video, but the intermediate 'processing' card (mentioned in spec) is hard to spot in the e2e run because the showcase 10s reel finished before 3s on this pod. Not a bug — render was just fast — but consider keeping the processing card visible for at least one polling tick for UX continuity.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest, incl. 3 full FFmpeg renders + TTS voice-over)

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates 3 reels (showcase+energetica@10s, services+voiceover+epica@15s, before_after@10s no-music) and 1 image post — all cleaned up via DELETE in TestReelsListDelete + image-post cleanup at end. Playwright run creates 1 reel and deletes it via reel-history-delete in the same script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_social_reels.py (pytest, self-cleaning). Run: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://unitech-ai-site.preview.emergentagent.com && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_social_reels.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/reels_results.xml`. Total wall time ~74s on this pod (3 FFmpeg renders + 1 TTS call). Validated Phase 2 endpoints: GET /api/social/music returns 6 tracks (energetica, corporativa, lofi, epica, alegre, urbana) each with /api/social/music/{id} url; GET /api/social/music/epica returns >1KB audio/mpeg; POST /api/social/reels accepts template={showcase|before_after|promo|services|testimonial}, motion={auto|zoom_in|zoom_out|pan}, transition={fade|deslizar|barrido|circulo|disolver|pixel}, subtitles/outro/voiceover bools, duration={10|15|20}, music={none|<6 tracks>|upload}; stored reel doc reflects all params; validation: before_after with 1 photo -> 400 'necesita 2 fotos', showcase with 0 photos -> 400; DELETE returns {ok:true} and second DELETE -> 404. Frontend selectors confirmed: reel-template-{5}, reel-duration-{10|15|20}, reel-motion-{4}, reel-transition-{6}, reel-subtitles-switch, reel-outro-switch, reel-voiceover-switch, reel-music-{8 incl. none+upload}, reel-music-preview-{id}, reel-color-{11}, reel-generate-btn, reel-video, reel-download-btn, reel-history, reel-history-{id}, reel-history-delete-{id}. before_after template visually disables the transition group via opacity-40 + pointer-events-none on the wrapper (buttons themselves remain not disabled at HTML level but un-clickable due to pointer-events:none — acceptable).
